facts.fact: A Standard opinion piece of 26 August 2026 says the Artificial Intelligence Bill 2026, sponsored by Senator Karen Nyamu, has been tabled in the Senate and proposes mandatory oversight of high-risk AI; the piece gives no tabling date, so the date is its publication date.
